correctness.rationale: The smoothness argument excludes common zeros on the quartic. Direct derivative elimination gives exactly the seven simple off-curve points U, whose Frobenius-linear parametrization spans an embedded Fano plane. A 21-point automorphism orbit plus three vertices and the Serre bound exhaust K(F8). Explicit tangent order-three computations prove 24 distinct flex tangents; the two representative tests show every tangent avoids U and the curve avoids all seven Fano lines. Counting lines in PG(2,8) forces equality with all 24 avoiding lines and tangent multiplicity partition 0^7,2^24,4^42. Two standalone independent GF8 presentations reproduce the relevant finite identities. Boundaries and quantifiers agree.

value.rationale: The obstruction in a point-maximal smooth genus-three plane curve is structurally explained: the complete tangent defect is a canonical reduced seven-point polar subplane and the rational tangent set is its full dual line-avoidance family, yielding all 73 point multiplicities. This is a motivated complete classification addressing the precise tangent-filling problem and supplies nontrivial geometry beyond tabulating a chosen finite set. It does not claim a general theorem for all finite fields.
